entries.title: Isaiah 44:1
segments: Yet now hear, O Jacob My servant, and Israel whom I have chosen;

entries.title: Isaiah 44:2
segments: So says the LORD who made you, and formed you from the womb, [who] will help you; Fear not, O Jacob My servant, and you, Jeshurun, whom I have chosen.

entries.title: Isaiah 44:3
segments: For I will pour water on him who is thirsty, and floods on the dry ground. I will pour My spirit on your seed, and My blessing on your offspring;

entries.title: Isaiah 44:4
segments: and they shall spring up [as] among the grass, as willows by the water-courses.

entries.title: Isaiah 44:5
segments: One shall say, I [am] the LORD's; and another shall call himself by the name of Jacob; and another shall write with his hand, For the LORD, and be named by the name of Israel.

entries.title: Isaiah 44:6
segments: So says the LORD, the King of Israel, and His redeemer the LORD of hosts; I [am] the first, and I [am] the last; and besides Me [there is] no God.

entries.title: Isaiah 44:7
segments: And who, as I, shall call, and shall declare it and set it in order for Me, since I placed the people of old? And the things that are coming, and shall come, let them declares to them.

entries.title: Isaiah 44:8
segments: Fear not, nor be afraid; have I not told you and made you hear since then? So you [are] My witnesses. Is there a God besides Me? Yea, [there is] none. I have not known a Rock.

entries.title: Isaiah 44:9
segments: Those who make a graven image [are] all of them vanity; and the things in which they delight shall not help; and they [are] their own witnesses. They do not see nor know, that they may be ashamed.

entries.title: Isaiah 44:10
segments: Who has formed a god, or melted a graven image that is good for nothing?

entries.title: Isaiah 44:11
segments: Behold, all his companions shall be ashamed; and the craftsmen; they [are] from men. They shall assemble; all of them shall stand; they shall dread; they shall be ashamed together.

entries.title: Isaiah 44:12
segments: He engraves iron with a tool. He works in the coals, and forms it with hammers, and works it with the strength of his arms. Then, he is hungry, and his strength fails; he drinks no water, and is weak.

entries.title: Isaiah 44:13
segments: He fashions wood, and stretches a line; he marks it out with a pencil; he shapes it with carving tools, and he marks it out with the compass, and makes it after the figure of a man, according to the beauty of a man, to sit [in the] house.

entries.title: Isaiah 44:14
segments: He cuts down cedars, and takes cypress and oak, which he makes the trees of the forest strong for him; he plants a tree, and the rain makes [it] grow.

entries.title: Isaiah 44:15
segments: And it shall be for a man to burn; for he will take some of it and warm himself. Yes, he kindles [it] and bakes bread; yes, he makes a god and worships; he makes it a graven image and falls down to it.

entries.title: Isaiah 44:16
segments: He burns part of it in the fire; with part of it he eats flesh; he roasts roast and is satisfied; yea, he warms [himself], and says, Aha, I am warm, I have seen the fire.

entries.title: Isaiah 44:17
segments: And the rest of it he makes into a god, his graven image; he falls down to it and worships, and prays to it, and says, Deliver me! for you [are] my god.

entries.title: Isaiah 44:18
segments: They have not known nor understood; for He has shut their eyes so that they cannot see; [and] their hearts so that they cannot understand.

entries.title: Isaiah 44:19
segments: And none thinks within his heart, nor [is there] knowledge nor understanding to say, I have burned part of it in the fire; yea, also I have baked bread on the coals of it; I have roasted flesh and eaten; and shall I make the rest of it an abomination? Shall I fall down to the stock of a tree?

entries.title: Isaiah 44:20
segments: He feeds on ashes; a deceived heart has turned him aside, so that he cannot deliver his soul, nor say, [Is there] not a lie in my right hand?

entries.title: Isaiah 44:21
segments: Remember these, O Jacob and Israel; for you [are] My servant; I have formed you; you [are] My servant; O Israel, you shall not be forgotten by Me.

entries.title: Isaiah 44:22
segments: I have blotted out, as a thick cloud, your transgressions, and, as a cloud, your sins; return to Me; for I have redeemed you.

entries.title: Isaiah 44:23
segments: Sing, O heavens; for the LORD has done [it]. Shout, lower parts of the earth. Break out into singing, O mountains, O forest, and every tree in it. For the LORD has redeemed Jacob, and glorified Himself in Israel.

entries.title: Isaiah 44:24
segments: So says the LORD, your Redeemer, and He who formed you from the womb, I [am] the LORD who makes all things; who stretches out the heavens alone; who spreads out the earth; who [was] with Me?

entries.title: Isaiah 44:25
segments: who brings to nothing the signs of the liars, and makes diviners mad; who turns the wise backward, and makes their knowledge foolish;

entries.title: Isaiah 44:26
segments: who makes the word of His servant sure, and makes good the counsel of His messengers; who says to Jerusalem, She shall have people; and to the cities of Judah, You shall be built, and I will raise up the waste places of it;

entries.title: Isaiah 44:27
segments: who says to the deep, Be dry, and I will dry up your rivers;

entries.title: Isaiah 44:28
segments: who says of Cyrus, [He is] My shepherd, and shall do all My pleasure; even saying to Jerusalem, You shall be built; and to the temple, Your foundation shall be laid.
